summary: Extends AGOA duty-free treatment for eligible sub-Saharan African imports and related apparel/fabric programs through December 31, 2028, with retroactive liquidation of post-expiration entries upon request, while also extending customs user fees through December 31, 2031.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on extending trade preferences and duty-free access for goods from sub-Saharan African countries, which is a clear move towards free trade by reducing barriers. The extension of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) is a central component of U.S. free trade policy with the region.
